introHtml: Jersey knit fabric offers a soft, breathable feel that moves with you on the course, making it a top choice for custom golf polo shirts. Unlike performance knits that can feel stiff, jersey material provides a classic, comfortable drape that holds up to repeated washing and embroidery. Whether you're outfitting a sales team for a tournament or supplying uniforms for a company outing, jersey polos offer reliable color retention and a professional look that keeps your brand front and center.
